name: NijiStream Official Extensions
author: nijistream
description: Official extension repository for NijiStream. All extensions provide actual video streaming.

extensions.name: HiAnime
extensions.changelog: v1.0.0: HiAnime streaming via aniwatch-api. Sub/Dub with subtitles. Primary streaming source.

extensions.name: AnimePahe
extensions.changelog: v1.0.0: AnimePahe streaming via Consumet API. High-quality MP4 with Sub/Dub.

extensions.name: AnimeSaturn
extensions.changelog: v1.0.0: AnimeSaturn streaming via Consumet API. Japanese audio with Italian subtitles. HLS streams.
